question: What ritual repetition involving the forehead syllable-mass is enjoined for the god-worshipped recipient?
premises: The practice involves what is situated in the forehead syllable-mass.
The required quantity of the act is one hundred thousand.
The instruction is addressed to one worshipped by the gods.
inference: One hundred thousand repetitions focused on the forehead syllable-mass are enjoined.
uncertainties: The exact nature of the act implied by kṛtya is not explicitly specified in this verse.
plain_english: O one worshipped by the gods, having performed one hundred thousand repetitions situated in the mass of syllables on the forehead.
